text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: So it's finally here. The last race of the Tiara tour… The Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer… I know we're short on time, but once we're in, there's somewhere I'd like to go first.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Well… it's complicated.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm coming in.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Scarlet?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You sure startle easily. Shouldn't a delinquent be more like, "The heck you doin' here?!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh, cram it. Why are you here anyways? The race is gonna start soon.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I know. This will only take a minute.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I take back what I said before. About calling you lame.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Besides, you're the one being lame!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: …What?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You gave up on the Tiara tour, right? You figured you couldn't get first place with me in the running.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Now, don't get me wrong.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You're a pain in the butt, you never make sense, and you're always mouthing off about cool this and cool that… Ugh, I'm getting mad just thinking about it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: If there's one thing you're not, it's lame.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: So I'm not gonna let you have first place. I won't let you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm going to win the Shuka Sho. I'll prove that I'm stronger than you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Not only to the crowd but to myself.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: So you'd better get ready—because you're going down.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You're gonna eat those words when I speed right past ya.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph! Talk is cheap. I'd like to see you try.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Now, let's get a move on, shall we? Our race awaits.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm going to beat her—no matter what!
